description: Each object in this list represents a single authorization test, and should have a name, request, and expected decision
markdownDescription:
Each object in this list represents a single authorization test, and should have a `name`, `request`, and expected `decision`.

Tests are evaluated against the Cedar policy (`*.cedar`), template links (`cedartemplatelinks.json`), and schema files alongside the tests file.

name.description: Name of this test, displayed in the Test Explorer

request.description: Can this principal take this action on this resource in this context?
request.markdownDescription: Can this `principal` take this `action` on this `resource` in this `context`?

principal.description: Entity making the request, for example App::User::"alice"

action.description: Action being requested, for example App::Action::"view"

resource.description: Entity being acted upon, for example App::Photo::"vacation.jpg"

context.description: Additional details about the request not tied to the principal, action, or resource

entities.description: Entities for this test. When omitted, the entities file (cedarentities.json) alongside the tests file is used.
entities.markdownDescription: Entities for this test. When omitted, the entities file (`cedarentities.json`) alongside the tests file is used.

reason.description: Expected policy ids which determine the decision. Static policies use their @id annotation, and template-linked policies use their link_id.
reason.markdownDescription: Expected policy ids which determine the decision. Static policies use their `@id` annotation, and template-linked policies use their `link_id`.

num_errors.description: Expected number of authorization (evaluation) errors, defaulting to 0 when omitted
num_errors.markdownDescription: Expected number of authorization (evaluation) errors.  Omitting `num_errors` is the same as `0`, so any evaluation error fails the test.

uid.description: The uid object specifies the Cedar type and unique identifier for the entity.
uid.markdownDescription: The `uid` object specifies the Cedar type and unique identifier for the entity.

parents.description: The parents object identifies other entities that represent containers in a hierarchy, such as a group that can contain users.
parents.markdownDescription: The `parents` object identifies other entities that represent containers in a hierarchy, such as a group that can contain users.

attrs.description: Use the attrs object to specify the key name and value of each attribute attached to the associated entity.
attrs.markdownDescription: Use the `attrs` object to specify the key name and value of each attribute attached to the associated entity.

tags.description: Tags are similar to attributes, but they can have key names which are known only dynamically (at run-time) and not when the policy/schema is authored.

type.description: The type must be a normalized entity type, i.e., without whitespace or Cedar comments.
